text:
maya: kicking off a tinywave canary for routing -> v2026.3 at 1% now. change window 09:00-11:00UTC. please monitor latency, 5xx, and cache OOMs for 15m. deploy-bot will post events. :eyes:

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started: service=routing tag=v2026.3 percent=1 initiator=maya window=09-11UTC

alex: noted. rollback criteria proposal: any sustained 5xx rate >=0.5% over 3m OR p99 > 400ms for 3m OR KV cache OOM spike.

maya: agree. document those in the release notes and ops runbook.

lina: tailing traces: https://telemetry/routing/live?tag=v2026.3 . initial p95 slightly up but no 5xx.

ryan: I'm ready to pin fallback. alex, do you want v2026.2-stable pinned as immediate fallback?

alex: yes pin it but keep it at 0% traffic (standby). deploy-bot can create a pin.

deploy-bot: executed: create-fallback service=routing fallback=v2026.2-stable status=ready pinned=true

lina: early sample traces (kv_miss=true correlate with higher tail):
```
trace: a1b2 sample route=/generate seq=192 kv_miss=true p99=428ms
trace: a1b3 sample route=/generate seq=64 kv_miss=false p99=190ms
```

alex: that looks like a cache correlation. If p99 > 400ms for 3 consecutive minutes we hold and run diag.

maya: proposal: hold at 1% until 09:15UTC. if stable then advance to 3%.

ryan: +1. I'll set a temporary route filter to redirect very long sequences (>256) to the fallback cluster while we watch.

ryan: deploying filter: seq>256 -> fallback. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: executed: route-update service=routing filter="seq>256" action=redirect fallback=v2026.2-stable

lina: after filter applied, p99 back down ~220ms and no 5xx. dashboard shows lower error risk.

maya: ok holding at 1% until 09:15UTC. alex, have rollback playbook ready. ryan, confirm filter stays for at least 30m or until we clear.

alex: prepping rollback steps and smoke tests now; will post checklist.

ryan: filter will remain until we explicitly remove it. filing infra ticket to check cache eviction settings for canary pool.

maya: final: interim hold, check again at 09:15UTC. tag @oncall if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
